title: Profile
subtitle: Language you learn, explanation language, level and daily load.

learning.label: Language you learn
learning.hint: Lessons, exercises and the tutor's speech use this language.

interface.label: Interface language
interface.hint: Labels and buttons of the application; switches immediately.

explanation.label: Explanation language
explanation.hint: The language the tutor explains rules and mistakes in: usually your own at A1 and the one you learn at C1.

level.label: CEFR level
level.hint: A level set by hand counts as a manual estimate; the placement test measures it.
level.sourcePlacementAt: determined by the placement test on {{date}}

goals.label: Learning goals
goals.hint: At least one goal is required: lessons are planned around it.
goals.empty: No goals yet. Type your own or pick a ready-made one.
goals.placeholder: For example: pass a job interview

errors.required: Add at least one goal: without it the tutor cannot plan a lesson.
errors.empty: Type the text of the goal.
errors.tooLong: A goal takes at most {{max}} characters.
errors.duplicate: This goal is already in the list.

interests.label: Interests
interests.hint: Topics for dialogues and materials; you can leave the list empty.
interests.empty: No interests yet. Type your own or pick a ready-made one.

errors.empty: Type the text of the interest.
errors.tooLong: An interest takes at most {{max}} characters.
errors.duplicate: This interest is already in the list.

dailyMinutes.label: Minutes a day
dailyMinutes.hint: How long you plan to study daily: from {{min}} to {{max}} minutes.
dailyMinutes.error: Enter a whole number of minutes from {{min}} to {{max}}.

form.invalid: Some fields are filled in incorrectly — check the messages next to them.
